messages:
olivia (customer): Hey team — started seeing 401s for SSO logins since yesterday evening. No app deploys on our side, users hitting ACS get 'InvalidSignature'. Any ideas?

maria (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the IdP metadata URL or the SignatureMethod snippet from their metadata? Also a short excerpt of the SAML log would help.

olivia (customer): metadata: https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml
Here is the error from our app logs: "SAML validation failed: InvalidSignature: digest algorithm not supported: http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#sha512"

maria (support): thanks — forwarding to eng-sre. @ashwin can you take a look?

ashwin (eng-sre): grabbing the metadata now. quick note: we've seen IdPs start signing with rsa-sha512 recently. Our verifier currently whitelists rsa-sha1 and rsa-sha256 only (legacy parsing assumptions).

ashwin (eng-sre): Metadata fragment:
```xml
<SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha512"/>
```

ashwin (eng-sre): SAML response validation fails because xmlsec reports UnsupportedDigestAlgorithm for sha512 during SignedInfo canonicalization/verify. Repro locally with curl + xmlsec:
```bash
curl -sS https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml > /tmp/idp.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --id-attr:ID Assertion /tmp/idp.xml
```
gets: "Error: Unsupported digest algorithm 'sha512'"

jin (infra): can we accept rsa-sha512 quickly? what are the risk matrix / compatibility checks?

ashwin (eng-sre): Compatibility wise sha512 is fine crypto-wise. Our runtime library (python-saml-wrapper) needs explicit mapping to xmlsec's sha512 constant. Patch is small: extend allowed SignatureMethod and DigestMethod lists. However need to ensure we don't accidentally accept none or weak algos.

maria (support): proposed remediation steps for customer: 1) ask IdP to re-sign with rsa-sha256 if they can do a quick rollback; OR 2) we push a guarded config change on our side to accept rsa-sha512 while we run extra tests. Which do you prefer @olivia?

olivia (customer): asking IdP team but they said they rolled out a security policy change to default to sha512 across tenants. prefer a fix on your side so we don't have to ask them to revert.

jin (infra): i can push a hotfix to staging to enable rsa-sha512 whitelist behind a feature flag. I'll run integration against their metadata and a few internal IdPs.

ashwin (eng-sre): quick patch diff:
```diff
- ALLOWED_SIGS = ["rsa-sha1", "rsa-sha256"]
+ ALLOWED_SIGS = ["rsa-sha1", "rsa-sha256", "rsa-sha512"]
```
also add DigestMethod mapping for sha512. unit tests added.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for change/allow-rsa-sha512 (rev 8f2a3).

jin (infra): deployed to staging, ran saml-interop test suite against idp.example.com metadata — verification passes

ashwin (eng-sre): can we do a controlled rollout? enable for Olivia's tenant id only, monitor signature validation errors and latency.

maria (support): rolled the flag on for tenant: olivia-corp (test window 15m). Please try login.

olivia (customer): re-tested — login now succeeds, no more InvalidSignature. thank you!! :tada:

jin (infra): will prepare prod rollout after 1h of green metrics. I'll open PR to add sha512 to our trusted algorithms and include a short rollback plan.

ashwin (eng-sre): followups: 1) add automated telemetry alert when new signature algos appear in incoming metadata, 2) update docs for supported SignatureMethod list, 3) add a note to runbook for SSO escalations.

maria (support): noted and assigning follow-up ticket to SSO runbook owners. closing this thread once prod deploy is done.

deploy-bot: prod deploy scheduled (canary then full) for change/allow-rsa-sha512 at 1728013800.
summary: Customer SSO failures after IdP started signing with rsa-sha512; eng patched verifier to allow sha512 behind flag, staged and enabled per-tenant; customer confirmed fix; follow-ups created.
